from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Optional
import dacite
@dataclass
class Loc:
    """
    A location of a trip such as a city, station, port or hotel
    """
    pageTitle:str
    id:Optional[str] # id of the location referenced by legs e.g. Bari
    name:Optional[str] # name of the location
    wikidataId:Optional[str] # Wikidata item of the location e.g. Q3519 for Bari; the link opens the map options of velorail
    latlon:Optional[str] # latitude and longitude of the location
    type:Optional[str] # type of the location
    country:Optional[str] # country of the location as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code e.g. IT
    url:Optional[str] # url of the location for reference or booking
    address:Optional[str] # postal address of the location
    notes:Optional[str] # notes on the location

    @classmethod
    def askQuery(cls):
        """
        get the ask Query for Loc

        Returns:
            str: the mediawiki markup for the ask query
        """
        ask="""{{#ask: [[Concept:Loc]]
|mainlabel=pageTitle
|?Loc id = id
|?Loc name = name
|?Loc wikidataId = wikidataId
|?Loc latlon = latlon
|?Loc type = type
|?Loc country = country
|?Loc url = url
|?Loc address = address
|?Loc notes = notes
|limit=10000
|format=table
}}"""
        return ask

    @classmethod
    def fromDict(cls,data:dict):
        """
        create a Loc from the given dict

        Args:
            data(dict): the dict to create the Loc from

        Returns:
            Loc: the freshly created Loc
        """
        loc=dacite.from_dict(data_class=cls,data=data)
        return loc
